# Best 3-in-1 Qi2 charging stands for iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods

**Best overall: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand (~$98 list, $80-90 at Amazon and Best Buy)**
WIRED's top pick. It has a chrome stand with a tilting iPhone pad, and it fast-charges Apple Watch Series 7 and newer. The iPhone pad is 15W, the AirPods spot is on the base, and the warranty is 2 years. [WIRED's review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Fastest, if you want 25W: Nomad Stand One Max ($169)**
It delivers Qi2 25W to the iPhone, and the build is heavy and glossy. It comes with a 6.6 ft cable but no power adapter, so you need a 40W one (Nomad's 40W Slim Adapter is $25). [WIRED's review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Best 25W value: ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 (~$100)**
- It charges at 25W Qi2.2 with an active cooling fan, and includes a 50W adapter.
- WIRED notes the fan has an off button for sleeping, and that the build is plastic rather than premium. [WIRED travel-charger guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/)
- Dealectric lists it at $99.99 and says code PARTNER18 takes $17.99 off at ESR's store, bringing it to about $82. I haven't verified this myself, so check at checkout. [Buy at ESR via Dealectric (affiliate link)](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand)
- Per Dealectric, 25W applies only to the iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus. The iPhone Air, 16 and 16 Pro get 20W, and older models get 15W.

**Best on a budget: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 (15W), about $40 on Amazon**
WIRED calls it the cheapest Qi2-certified 3-in-1 it has found. It has a secure magnetic pad and ships with a charger and cable. The Apple Watch charger is a separate unit that slots into the back. [WIRED's review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Best desk stand that folds for travel: Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable, Qi2 25W ($129.99)**
Macworld calls it the tallest and most adjustable foldable 3-in-1 it has tested, with a 160° viewing angle and a 45W adapter included. It's heavier than rivals at 399g. [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html)

## Which should you get?
- **Charging overnight:** WIRED says 25W makes little difference here, so the Belkin or the budget ESR is enough.
- **Want the fastest iPhone top-ups:** The ESR CryoBoost is the cheapest 25W option. The Nomad is the more premium one.
- **Check your AirPods case:** It must support wireless charging to work on the base pad.

I'd start with the Belkin, or the ESR CryoBoost if you have a recent iPhone and want 25W.
